tasks.short: Check new Recruitee applicants against the vacancy's must-haves and pass the suitable ones to the hiring manager.

today.trigger: New applications land in Recruitee, often in batches after a vacancy is posted or during seasonal peaks.
steps: Open each candidate in Recruitee and read the CV and motivation
Check hard requirements (driving licence C/CE, code 95, forklift or VCA certificate, shift availability, right to work)
Move suitable candidates to the 'hiring manager review' stage and reject or park the rest
Email or Teams-message the hiring manager with a short list and a note per candidate
drudgery: Reading the same CV fields over and over to find licence and certificate details
Chasing hiring managers who do not open Recruitee
today.time_sinks: High-volume warehouse and driver vacancies with many incomplete or unsuitable applications, plus manual write-ups for managers.

lenses.faster: An LLM extracts licences, certificates, availability and location from each CV into fixed fields, so the administrator checks a table instead of reading every CV.
lenses.autonomous: On each new application, Recruitee screening questions plus the extraction step tag candidates as 'meets must-haves', 'missing X' or 'unclear'; nothing is rejected without a person.
lenses.ambitious: Every applicant gets a response within two working days and every hiring manager gets a consistent one-page shortlist, even at the seasonal peak.
lenses.joy: No more retyping CV details for managers; the administrator spends time on borderline candidates and calling people back.
lenses.options: For a hard-to-fill role the administrator can see three cut-offs (strict, with training offered, with flex-to-permanent route) and the candidate count for each.
lenses.altitude: The administrator owns the must-have criteria per job family with the recruiters and checks a weekly sample of tags for errors and bias.
reach: Recruiter first-line phone screening for volume roles
Pre-filling the hiring manager's interview scorecard

tasks.human_edge: Judging borderline and non-standard CVs (foreign licences, career gaps, internal candidates) and knowing what each manager actually needs on the floor.
tasks.pattern_why: Unstructured CVs become structured must-have fields inside a fixed Recruitee workflow; the decision to refer or reject stays with a person because candidate screening is high-risk under the EU AI Act.

in_practice.trigger: Candidate enters the 'Applied' stage in Recruitee.
steps: Recruitee screening questions capture licence, certificates, shift availability and location
LLM step reads CV and answers, fills structured fields and flags contradictions
Rules tag the candidate as meets / missing item / unclear
Administrator reviews tags, moves candidates and adds a note
Hiring manager receives a weekly or per-batch shortlist in Teams
in_practice.human_gate: Administrator decides every move to hiring manager review and every rejection; no automated rejection.
data_needed: Recruitee candidate data and screening answers
Sample of past referral decisions for checking
in_practice.logs_to: Recruitee candidate timeline plus a screening log (criteria version, extracted fields, human decision) in SharePoint.

evidence.claim: Recruitee supports screening questions on application forms and pipeline stages for moving candidates.
LLMs reliably extract structured fields such as licence types and certificates from CVs.
AI systems used to filter or evaluate job applicants are classed as high-risk under the EU AI Act Annex III.
evidence.source: EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689), Annex III point 4

risks: EU AI Act high-risk obligations (human oversight, logging, transparency to candidates) if the tool influences selection
Indirect discrimination if extraction misreads foreign qualifications or names
Works council right of consent (WOR art. 27) on a system that processes applicant data
AVG: CV data sent to a model provider needs a processing agreement and EU hosting
research_questions: What share of applications for driver and warehouse roles fail on a hard must-have that a form question could catch?
How accurate is extraction of licence and certificate data on 200 past Noordhaven CVs, including Polish and Romanian ones?
Does the OR see this as a consent-requiring personnel tracking or selection system?
Do hiring managers want a shortlist summary or would they rather read the CVs themselves?

tasks.short: Send applicants the yes or no after a decision, by email or phone, from Recruitee.

today.trigger: A candidate is rejected at any stage or a hiring manager confirms an offer.
steps: Check the decision in Recruitee or in a manager's email
Pick an email template and adjust name, role and reason
Call candidates who interviewed, then send the email
Update the candidate stage and close the vacancy when filled
drudgery: Copy-editing the same rejection template dozens of times
Chasing managers for a decision so candidates are not left waiting
today.time_sinks: Waiting for decisions, personalising emails after interviews, and bulk rejections when a vacancy closes.

lenses.faster: Stage moves in Recruitee trigger the right template automatically; an LLM drafts a short personalised line for interviewed candidates from the interview feedback.
lenses.autonomous: Pre-interview rejections go out automatically after a delay once a person moves the candidate; vacancies auto-close remaining candidates with a polite note when filled.
lenses.ambitious: Every candidate hears back within five working days and interviewed candidates get specific, useful feedback, which helps the company's name in a tight logistics labour market.
lenses.joy: No more bulk copy-paste; the administrator keeps the phone calls to finalists and the offer call.
lenses.options: Three drafted tones for a sensitive rejection (internal candidate, rehire, near miss) to pick from.
lenses.altitude: The administrator maintains the template set and the stage rules in Recruitee and monitors candidate response times.

tasks.human_edge: Phone calls to finalists and internal candidates, handling upset or disputing candidates, and delivering offers.
tasks.pattern_why: Stage changes are structured events and templates are fixed; only the personalised feedback line needs a model, and that is reviewed before sending.

in_practice.trigger: Candidate moved to 'Rejected' or 'Hired' stage, or vacancy set to filled in Recruitee.
steps: Recruitee automation selects the template by stage and rejection reason
Pre-interview rejections are scheduled with a 24 to 48 hour delay
For interviewed candidates an LLM drafts one or two feedback sentences from scorecards
Administrator approves the interviewed-candidate emails and makes finalist calls
Vacancy closure sends remaining candidates a closing note and a talent-pool opt-in
in_practice.human_gate: Person decides the stage move; administrator approves any message with personalised feedback.

evidence.claim: Recruitee offers email templates and automated actions when candidates move between pipeline stages.
LLMs can draft short, polite feedback from structured interview notes.

risks: Wrong template to the wrong candidate (an offer tone sent as rejection) if stage moves are made by mistake
Feedback text that reveals discriminatory reasoning from interview notes
AVG retention: talent-pool opt-in must be explicit and time-limited
research_questions: How long do candidates wait today between decision and notification, by stage?
Which Recruitee automation features are in Noordhaven's current licence tier?
Do interviewed candidates want written feedback, and do managers' scorecards contain usable reasons?

tasks.short: Handle pension, lease bike, travel allowance and other benefit enrolments and changes in AFAS, and answer employee questions.

today.trigger: New hire, life event, contract change, or an employee question about pension, travel allowance, bike plan or WGA/WIA insurance.
steps: Receive the request by email, form or at the HR desk
Check eligibility in the CAO and the policy on SharePoint
Enter or change the benefit in AFAS Profit and send data to pension fund or insurer
Answer the employee and file the paperwork
Reconcile monthly changes with the Payroll Specialist before the payroll run
drudgery: Looking up the same CAO articles for recurring questions
Double entry between AFAS and external portals
today.time_sinks: Questions from shift workers who cannot easily reach HR, and cross-checking changes against payroll deadlines.

lenses.faster: A copilot answers the administrator's eligibility questions from the CAOs and policies with article references, and drafts the employee reply.
lenses.autonomous: AFAS workflows route benefit change requests from self-service, check standard eligibility rules and queue them for approval; a nightly check lists changes not yet passed to payroll.
lenses.ambitious: Every employee, including night-shift warehouse staff and flex workers converting to contract, gets a clear personal overview of their benefits in Dutch, English or Polish.
lenses.joy: Less looking up articles and re-keying; more time for the employees with complex situations like long-term illness or divorce.
lenses.options: For an employee choosing pension or bike options, the copilot shows two or three worked examples of net effect to discuss.
lenses.altitude: The administrator keeps the rule set and the Q&A source documents current after each CAO change and reviews the exception queue.
reach: Compensation and Benefits Specialist's routine eligibility questions
Payroll Specialist's pre-run benefit change check

tasks.human_edge: Sensitive cases (illness, death, divorce, disability), judgement on exceptions, and trust at the HR desk.
tasks.pattern_why: The administrator stays the lead on benefit decisions with legal and pay effects; AI speeds up lookup, drafting and checks.

in_practice.trigger: Benefit change request in AFAS self-service, email to HR, or new contract in AFAS.
steps: AFAS workflow captures the request with required fields
Copilot retrieves the relevant CAO and policy text and suggests eligibility with source
Administrator decides and processes the change in AFAS
Copilot drafts the reply in the employee's language
Nightly report lists changes pending for payroll and external portals
in_practice.human_gate: Administrator approves every benefit change and every reply with a financial statement.
data_needed: Current CAO texts and benefit policies

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports self-service and workflows for HR change requests.
Microsoft 365 Copilot can answer questions grounded in SharePoint documents.

risks: Wrong eligibility answer from an outdated CAO version leads to pay errors
Special category data (health, disability) in prompts under AVG
Employees treating a drafted answer as a binding promise
research_questions: Which ten benefit questions make up most of the volume, and are they answerable from documents alone?
How many benefit changes per month miss the payroll cut-off today?
Is AFAS self-service used by warehouse staff, or do they need a different channel?

tasks.short: Post vacancies on the website, job boards and internally, and tell eligible staff and flex workers about openings.

today.trigger: Approved vacancy request from a manager.
steps: Get the vacancy text from the manager or reuse an old one
Edit the text, check CAO scale and requirements
Publish through Recruitee to the careers site and job boards
Post internally on the intranet or Teams and on warehouse notice boards
Ask agencies to tell suitable flex workers
today.time_sinks: Back and forth with managers on the text and finding who internally is eligible.

lenses.faster: An LLM drafts the vacancy text from the approved request, job profile and CAO scale; the administrator edits instead of writing.
lenses.autonomous: When a vacancy is approved, Recruitee publishes it, Teams posts it internally, and a list of eligible internal staff and long-serving flex workers is produced from AFAS and Studytube certificates.
lenses.ambitious: Every vacancy is offered first to current flex workers and staff with the right certificates, turning flex-to-permanent into a real hiring channel.
lenses.joy: No more blank-page writing or printing; the administrator spends time talking to internal candidates.
lenses.options: Three versions of the text (formal, plain for warehouse, short for social media) and Dutch, English and Polish variants.
lenses.altitude: The administrator maintains job profile templates and the internal-first rules and tracks which channels produce hires who stay 90 days.
reach: Recruiter channel planning and job board choice
L&D linking vacancies to certificate training

tasks.human_edge: Agreeing the real requirements with the manager and personally approaching internal candidates.
tasks.pattern_why: Several steps across Recruitee, Teams, AFAS and agency portals; text and eligible lists need a person's approval before they go out.

in_practice.trigger: Vacancy request approved in AFAS or Recruitee.
steps: Agent drafts vacancy text from job profile, CAO scale and request
Agent builds internal eligibility list from AFAS and Studytube certificates
Administrator edits text and approves list
Agent publishes via Recruitee, posts in Teams and notifies agencies
Administrator contacts top internal candidates personally
in_practice.human_gate: Administrator approves text, channels and internal list before publishing.
data_needed: Flex worker tenure from agency portals
in_practice.logs_to: Recruitee vacancy history and a channel log in SharePoint.

evidence.claim: Recruitee publishes vacancies to the careers site and multiple job boards from one place.
Recruitee offers AI-assisted job description writing.

risks: Biased or exclusionary wording in drafted texts
Using flex worker data from agency portals may need agreement with agencies under AVG
Internal list missing people whose certificates are not in Studytube
research_questions: How many hires in the last year came from internal staff or flex workers, and how did they do at 90 days?
Can agency portals export flex worker tenure and certificates in a usable way?
Does the OR have agreements on internal-first posting periods?

tasks.short: Look up employee data in AFAS for authorised requests like employer statements for mortgages, UWV or agencies.

today.trigger: Request from an employee (werkgeversverklaring), UWV, bailiff, pension fund or another authorised party.
steps: Check who is asking and whether they are authorised or have the employee's consent
Look up contract, salary and dates in AFAS Profit
Fill in the statement or form
Get it signed and send it securely
File the request and response in the employee dossier
drudgery: Re-keying the same contract and salary fields into different bank forms
Checking identity and consent each time
today.time_sinks: Urgent mortgage statements and bailiff wage garnishment letters with deadlines.

lenses.faster: Standard statements (werkgeversverklaring, employment proof) are generated from AFAS data into the right template; the administrator checks and signs.
lenses.autonomous: Employees request a standard statement via AFAS self-service and get a draft generated overnight for the administrator to approve.
lenses.ambitious: Every employee gets a correct employer statement within one day, which matters to warehouse staff buying a home.
lenses.joy: No more retyping salary figures; the administrator focuses on bailiff and legal requests that need care.
lenses.options: Not much use here; the output is fixed by the requester's format.
lenses.altitude: The administrator owns the template library and the authorisation rules and audits a sample of outgoing statements.

tasks.human_edge: Deciding whether a requester is authorised and handling legal requests like garnishments under AVG.
tasks.pattern_why: Data comes from structured AFAS fields and templates are fixed; an LLM is only needed to read the incoming request letter.

in_practice.trigger: Request in AFAS self-service or received by email.
steps: LLM classifies incoming email request and extracts requester and fields needed
Rules check consent or legal basis
AFAS data merges into the correct template
Administrator verifies and signs
Sent via secure mail and stored in dossier
in_practice.human_gate: Administrator approves authorisation and signs each document.
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS employee dossier with request and response.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit can generate documents from employee data using templates.

risks: Disclosure to an unauthorised party breaches AVG
Wrong salary figure on a mortgage statement
Phishing requests posing as banks or bailiffs
research_questions: What volume and mix of requests arrive per month, and how many are standard statements?
Does the current werkgeversverklaring template match the NHG format banks require?
Which legal bases apply to each requester type?

tasks.short: Make monthly and ad-hoc HR reports: headcount, verzuim, turnover, hires, certificates, for managers, OR and directors.

today.trigger: Month end, OR meeting, management request, or audit.
steps: Export data from AFAS, Recruitee and Studytube
Clean and combine in Excel
Build tables and charts
Write a short commentary
Send to the requester
drudgery: Same exports and Excel steps every month
Fixing mismatched employee IDs between systems
today.time_sinks: Ad-hoc requests that need a new cut of the data.

lenses.faster: Standard reports come from Power BI on the nightly AFAS extract; an LLM drafts the commentary.
lenses.autonomous: Power BI subscriptions send managers their site report on the first working day of the month.
lenses.ambitious: Each site manager gets a monthly view of verzuim, certificates expiring and 90-day retention linked to the North Star.
lenses.joy: No more monthly Excel rebuilds; time goes to explaining trends.
lenses.options: Different cuts per audience (OR, director, site manager) from the same data.
lenses.altitude: The administrator defines report needs with the People Analytics Analyst and checks data quality.
reach: People Analytics Analyst's routine report requests

tasks.human_edge: Knowing which numbers are sensitive and interpreting them for each audience.
tasks.pattern_why: Structured data with fixed definitions; dashboards and scheduled reports run without a model, with an LLM only for commentary drafts.

steps: Nightly extract refreshes Power BI
Scheduled reports go to subscribers
LLM drafts commentary from the numbers
Administrator reviews commentary and handles ad-hoc questions
in_practice.human_gate: Administrator approves commentary and any report going to the OR or outside HR.
data_needed: Extracts from Recruitee and Studytube joined to AFAS
in_practice.logs_to: Power BI workspace and SharePoint report archive.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports scheduled email subscriptions to reports.
Copilot in Power BI can draft narrative summaries of report visuals.

risks: Small groups in reports could identify individuals (verzuim data under AVG)
Wrong metric definitions spread automatically
research_questions: Which reports are made monthly by hand, and how many hours each?
Can Recruitee and Studytube data be added to the nightly extract?
What does the OR want to see regularly?

tasks.short: Keep org charts, handbook, staff directory and HR forms on SharePoint up to date.

today.trigger: Org change, new policy, CAO change, or annual review.
steps: Notice a change from AFAS or an email
Edit the org chart in Visio or PowerPoint
Update handbook text and forms in Word
Publish on SharePoint and announce
drudgery: Finding all documents that mention an old rule
today.time_sinks: Org charts going stale and handbook updates after a CAO change.

lenses.faster: Org charts are generated from AFAS reporting lines; an LLM finds all handbook passages affected by a CAO change and drafts edits.
lenses.autonomous: Org chart and directory refresh nightly from AFAS; changed sections queue for review.
lenses.ambitious: A current handbook in Dutch, English and Polish for every warehouse worker.
lenses.joy: No more redrawing boxes; time goes to making policies readable.
lenses.options: Two or three wording options for a changed policy section.
lenses.altitude: The administrator owns the document set and approval flow, not the edits.

tasks.human_edge: Approving policy wording with legal and OR implications.
tasks.pattern_why: Org charts are deterministic, document edits need a model and a human approval before publishing.

in_practice.trigger: AFAS org change or a new CAO or policy version.
steps: Nightly generation of org chart and directory from AFAS
LLM finds affected handbook passages and drafts edits
Administrator and HR BP approve
Publish on SharePoint with version history
in_practice.human_gate: HR approves every policy text change; OR consent where WOR art. 27 applies.

evidence.claim: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word can rewrite and summarise documents.
Org charts can be generated from HR data, e.g. Visio data visualizer from Excel.

risks: Publishing changed policy without OR consent
Mistranslation of policy in other languages
AFAS reporting lines incorrect
research_questions: How accurate are AFAS reporting lines today?
How many handbook sections changed after the last CAO?
Does the OR accept translated versions as equal?

role.altitude: From doing HR administration by hand to running the HR admin system: keeping templates, rules, workflows and data quality in AFAS, Recruitee and Power BI correct, and handling the exceptions.
reach: Recruiter volume screening and candidate communication
Payroll Specialist pre-run checks on benefit changes and garnishment intake
Compensation and Benefits routine eligibility questions
role.ceiling_note: About 40 to 50 percent of these tasks' hours can go; the limit is legal and trust work (authorisation, sensitive cases, OR consent, EU AI Act oversight for candidate screening) and data quality across AFAS, Recruitee and Studytube.
skills_to_grow: Power BI basics and metric definitions
Writing and testing prompts and templates
AVG and EU AI Act basics for HR data
role.ambitious_version: The two administrators run a self-service HR desk for all 1,200 employees and the flex pool, in several languages, with internal-first hiring and same-day statements, and spend their time on the exceptions and on improving the rules.
